summary: Scanner reads only git objects via argv (no shell, no FS traversal, symlink/import escapes rejected), but repo-controlled config globs enable regex backtracking DoS, blob reads are unbounded, and the new orchestrator text widens the trust boundary for executed build/test commands to vendored/linked reference files.

findings.summary: Globs from repo-controlled .factory/config.json compile to backtracking regexes matched against every tracked path, so a short committed glob hangs instructions-record at every preflight.
findings.evidence: glob_regex maps `*` to `[^/]*` and `**/` to `(?:.*/)?` with no limit on wildcard count; _config_globs compiles every include/reference/exclude glob, and scan calls listed() for each candidate and for every path in sorted(tree) (lines 440-441, 493-496, 471). Measured: glob_regex('*a'*8+'z').match('a'*40) took 0.55s and grows steeply per extra `*a`, so ~20 chars across thousands of paths runs for hours. _git has no timeout. For adoption the config comes from a foreign branch ref. ENG-24 (bounds on untrusted work), ENG-25 (validate untrusted input).
findings.fix: Match globs without backtracking regexes, e.g. a segment-wise matcher using fnmatch per path segment with iterative `**` handling, or collapse consecutive wildcards and reject globs above a small wildcard/length limit (note it in notes as 'instructions config ignored'). Add a test with a pathological glob that must finish within a time bound.

findings.summary: Scan reads whole repo-controlled blobs into memory with no size cap, and a config include of `**` reads every tracked blob with one git process per file.
findings.evidence: read_blobs returns full `git cat-file --batch` stdout for all candidates at once (capture_output, no size check); merge() -> read() -> blob(oid) spawns read_blobs(repo,[oid]) per uncached file (lines 416-419), so `"include": ["**"]` in the committed .factory/config.json reads and hashes every file in the repo, including large binaries, and keeps all contents in `info`. A single multi-GB tracked AGENTS.md is likewise read fully. ENG-24, ENG-21.
findings.fix: Get sizes first (`git cat-file --batch-check` or `ls-tree -l`) and skip entries above a per-file cap (e.g. 1 MiB) with a note, and cap the total bytes or entry count read through config include/reference matches. Batch the merge-time reads instead of starting one process per blob.

findings.summary: Documented build/test commands are now taken from every root-scope index entry, and the scanner gives root scope to vendored ADRs and to any file linked from nested vendored agent files, so third-party text can become the executed commands without confirmation.
findings.evidence: SKILL.md step 5: 'take documented build and test commands from every root-scope entry of the index (`scope` `["/"]`) ... documented commands win'; only same-tier conflicts and detector proposals get confirmation. instructions.py: _is_adr matches an `adr`/`adrs` directory at any depth and returns scope ['/'] (lines 218-226, 243-244); links from any non-reference entry, including nested scoped files like vendor/x/CLAUDE.md, merge with ('/',) scope (lines 519-523); config `reference` entries are also ('/',). Before this change, only the root CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md were read for commands. ENG-25 (enforce trust at boundaries).
findings.fix: Limit command sourcing to root-scope `always` entries from source catalogue/governance/config-include (exclude source `link` and `reference` kind and ADRs), or require the setup-commands confirmation, including under cruise, whenever a command comes from anything other than a root catalogue agent file.

findings.summary: The user-supplied --ref goes to git rev-parse as a positional with no `--end-of-options`, so a value starting with '-' is parsed as an option.
findings.evidence: _git(repo, ['rev-parse', '--verify', '--quiet', f'{ref}^{{commit}}']) with ref taken from `--ref` (cli.py) or from state branch/base. Appending ^{commit} makes a working exploit unlikely today, but the argument is not marked as data. ENG-25.
findings.fix: Reject a ref that starts with '-' with a ScanError, or insert '--end-of-options' before the revision argument (git >= 2.24).
